specification.objective: Re-enable the dedicated project Kanban with a minimal static renderer after the diagnostic probe proved the shell and non-scrollable workspace path render correctly. Render real columns and cards with only a horizontal SingleChildScrollView and Row, while temporarily excluding ListView, ReorderableListView, Draggable, DragTarget, and reorder handles so rendering stability can be verified before drag-and-drop is reintroduced.

requirements.statement: ProjectKanbanPage must mount KanbanBoardView again for the loaded board and remove the temporary diagnostic probe.
KanbanBoardView must render board columns with a horizontal SingleChildScrollView whose content is a Row of fixed-width column panels.
The diagnostic renderer must not mount ListView, ReorderableListView, Draggable, LongPressDraggable, DragTarget, or ReorderableDragStartListener anywhere in KanbanBoardView.

Column create/rename/delete, card create/edit/delete, and assignee management controls must remain wired to the existing callbacks; card and column movement callbacks remain part of the widget contract but are intentionally not mounted in this slice.

ProjectKanbanPage must remain dedicated and continue using WorkspaceScaffold with contentScrollable false; backend, API, persistence, authorization, and ProjectTasksController behavior must remain unchanged.
The locked Change Contract must be versioned at docs/contracts/project-kanban-static-renderer-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The dedicated page renders KanbanBoardView and no longer renders the diagnostic probe text.
KanbanBoardView source uses SingleChildScrollView with Axis.horizontal and a Row for its column surface.
KanbanBoardView source contains none of the excluded list/reorder/drag primitives.
The static board still exposes column and card management controls and renders real column/card data, while movement callbacks are preserved but not mounted.
The page remains contentScrollable false and the payload does not modify workspace shell, controller, backend, API, database, or authorization files.
The locked schema-v4 contract is present at docs/contracts/project-kanban-static-renderer-v1.polis.json.

invariants.statement: The rendering probe result remains the causal baseline: shell, project selector, controller loading, and board data are known to render correctly without KanbanBoardView.
No new Flutter dependency is introduced.
Existing Kanban domain and optimistic-concurrency semantics remain untouched.

forbidden_states.statement: ProjectKanbanPage still substitutes the diagnostic probe for KanbanBoardView.
KanbanBoardView mounts any ListView, ReorderableListView, Draggable, LongPressDraggable, DragTarget, or ReorderableDragStartListener.
The change modifies WorkspaceScaffold, renderer bootstrap, backend, API, persistence, authorization, or controller behavior.
The Kanban is moved back into ProjectTasksPage.

inputs.statement: The confirmed diagnostic state at commit 76e7eae858fe9507319bd137e720b9ea0424ba32, where the placeholder renders correctly with the same shell, controller, and board data.
A loaded Kanban board with zero or more columns/cards on wide or narrow Flutter Web viewports.

outputs.statement: A dedicated Kanban screen that renders actual board columns/cards through a minimal static widget tree.
A controlled runtime surface suitable for verifying whether basic horizontal board composition is stable before any drag-and-drop capability is restored.

failure_semantics.statement: If the page does not mount KanbanBoardView, the diagnostic text remains, the static horizontal Row renderer is absent, or an excluded list/reorder/drag primitive remains, validation fails closed with project_kanban_static_renderer_missing.
Flutter/Dart tooling is unavailable in the artifact-production environment, so widget tests are included but must not be represented as executed here.
